chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man in his mid-20s, short black hair, light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers, holding a ring of keys
chars.LADY: an elegant Moroccan woman around 35, wearing a long burgundy coat, a loosely tied cream headscarf, gold hoop earrings, carrying a brown leather handbag
chars.DAD: a Moroccan man around 60 with a grey moustache, wearing a navy cardigan over a white shirt and beige trousers
